They were among the oldest living beings in the Land of Dawn, devouring elemental creatures for power, causing them to be imprisoned in this deepest place by the Ancients. The powerful Injunction blocked light, heat and their path upwards. In the endless darkness, there is no fight or conflict, only the law of survival: existence, alternation and circulation.
fr|en|Cependant, au fil des siècles, cer: However, over the centuries, some things have gradually changed. Changes are not born under the ocean but from above. fr|en|Le Madien du Glacier qui accorde l: The Madian of the Glacier who grants the sternal remebrane in the legends of the North. Aurora, the Glacier Maiden, who commands the unwavering faith of countless northern mortals, grants eternity to the world. In her youth, she endured the torment of her innate prowess for Frost Magic until the disciples of the Light brought her to Queen's Peak, after which she received an infusion of light that granted her immortality. In tears, her mother bid her farewell as she succumbed to the cold embrace of the blizzard. Aurora slept for a thousand years atop the peak. When he woke up, the truth dawned on him: true eternity lay in fleeting emotions, like his mother's last comforting smile. Thus, Aurora resolved to grant this eternity to the world. It was at this moment that a legend was born in the North. Legend spoke of people near death who would climb Queen's Peak, seeking the icy embrace of the goddess. If this were granted, all of the person's memories, desires, and emotions would be left to the goddess, who would cherish them until the end of time. And so, they would live for eternity. === The Ballad of the Glaciers === As the embers of the campfire die down and the incessant snowy night begins to unfold, the story of the Glacier Maiden returns to form in immortal hymns. Aurora's fingertips possess the power of freezing snow, but how come she possesses such power? What kind of past is hidden in the memories she lost?

fr|en|Alors que les braises du feu de ca: As the embers of the campfire die down and the relentless snowy night begins to unfold, the history of Northern Vale takes shape again in immortal hymns. Raise your voices, children, and let the echoes resonate. For we sing of frozen realms, of eternity unleashed, of the majestic birth of Queen's Peak, all in the embrace of a single day. The saga takes root in the wake of a distant war where, with our dreams held close to our breasts, we shared sleep. The fiery blaze of the Iceland Golem challenged the divine, and the deity of light summoned the power of glaciers, all adorned with sublime design. The passage of four millennia, the colossal hand of time, has swept away the deities and rebels of the land. The glaciers remained silent, the icy expanse so still, until a young girl awoke, freeing herself from her bonds. His fingers governed the icy reign of snow, his veil was the frost, where the light would remain. Aurora, the young girl of the glacier, eternal and grandiose. His memory was blank, flooded by the icy call of the night, but the divinity's command resonated with the echoes of the roar of the avalanches. "Grant eternity to the world and descend, fair goddess, from the icy lair of Queen's Peak." In the vast snowfields of the North Valley lies the path of the Glacier Maiden. Mortals sang praises, prayers fervent and bold, tales etched in snowflakes, a story to behold. “Send eternity, O goddess above!” “Let the winds and snow purify our destinies forever!” A divine decree, a mission veiled in mist, but Aurora found the words enigmatic and unpredictable. Ephemeral snowflakes, in search of eternal grace. But what is “eternity”? In the frozen lands, the answer lies in its hiding place.

fr|en|Dans le labyrinthe du cœur, comme: In the labyrinth of the heart, like snowflakes dancing in disorder, prayers to the goddess linger, but her hands must not swing in despair. Unwilling to bear the painful tears, Aurora sets out on a quest for eternity, through untamed realms, which she will travel until her last day. As glaciers reflect the purest icy glow, the goddess rushes where destinies flow. In the icy path she wanders, searching, however, Aurora returns to her primordial home below. The burdens of the world, broken by the power of the blizzard, once prosperous villages, now lie in ruins in the night. No hearth fire, their ancient warm delight. The snowflakes on his cheek sing, the memories disappear in the blink of an eye. The glaciers of the North, dazzlingly pure, a divine miracle, a radiant spectacle. A millennium has passed, pious souls have gathered on this sacred land, with invisible respect. They chose a gifted child, in the serene sacred light, to forge celestial wings. Glory, the greatest lure, in the wake of temptation, mother confided to Aurora, with complete confidence, the summit of the glacier, secrets still invisible. A tender abandoned girl, the ephemeral sparkle of love. Here, memories arise as the goddess reveals the enigmatic screen of eternity, cold but vivid. If eternity is insensible in its icy pride, what it grants to mortals are endless farewells for the whole world. Why not seal eternity within you, O divine goddess, and return to the mountains, according to the design of destiny. Aurora heads to claim the glacier, through snow and storm, as tears intertwine. The North Valley, in the vibrant flame of empathy, reveals an enigma, an assigned truth. While icy winds reveal an ancient snowy path, a millennium past, the evil destiny of the mother, an icy prison, a sad claim. The frozen tendrils glow with radiant flame, Aurora contemplates the last memory of her mother. A thousand years ago, in such a fragile village, snow and storms threatened the roofs, a sad story. Fragile frame, gift of frost, her strength would weaken, Aurore, sick, would become a spectral trail. “Heavens, have mercy, may not my snowflake be fragile,” a helpless mother prayed to the glaciers, but to no avail. The faithful disciples, like angels, set sail. Up to Queen's Peak, they carried Aurora without fail. Cold, biting winds could neither deter nor slow her down. A resolute mother, she braved the frost, the work of her heart. Under a hundred supplications, a poignant and tearful revelation, the mother met her beloved daughter, in the smallest details of the ice. Of ice and snow, an ethereal dress, beyond the pale, a radiant veil of light, in the grand design of destiny. No more pain, no more affliction, in the eternal trail, Aurora, pure and beautiful, beyond the fragility of life. The faithful of the light, with the divine voice, declared to the mother, in a solemn tone: "Beside you, her life, ephemeral design, in the embrace of the glacier, Aurora will shine!" A brief goodbye kiss, left behind, with tears in his eyes, his mother's heart embraced. She would not deprive her daughter of her light, so kind, alone on her journey, against the snow. A thousand years of snow, an epic grid, a mother and a glacier, combined into eternity. In the frozen tomb, their souls aligned.

fr|en|Les flocons de neige tombent comme: Snowflakes fall like the whispered rhyme of glaciers. “O Aurora, O Dawn”, through the chime of eternities, the heritage of a daughter, the prayer of a mother at her peak. In the eternal ice, an ephemeral goodbye frozen in time. Queen's Peak holds the truth, a story of hope and filth, a mother torn between despair and hope, in the prime of her life. In the glacial hold, where the lights of the aurora shine, her dress, a shimmering dance, her braids, icy tendrils in a frigid climate. Aurora's Frost Magic, in her resplendent bloom, the goddess of the glacier, dispelling the icy darkness. She grasped the deep suit of eternity to listen to the prayers of humanity and the melody of its heart. No enigma, this enigma, in an ancient heritage, a gift from his mother, beyond the earthly tomb. “What makes the glacier eternal are myriads of ephemeral snowflakes and the sweet scent of emotions.” As the embers of the bonfire die out, through the endless snow-filled night, faith in the Glacier Maiden spreads everywhere. Mortal lives, an ephemeral tide, like sparks in flight, only his presence endures, in eternal power. With her fingertips, she guides the icy bite of the snow, its veil, a shimmering coat of light, one might imply. Although the glaciers disappear and the ice fields begin to slide, the goddess of Queen's Peak stands tall with unwavering pride. Back up the glacier, oh souls about to fly away, carry your memories, your thoughts, your laughter and much more. In his presence, O souls, your wishes implore, for the refuge of your spirits, to explore forever. She will grant you snow, ice and warmth, in Her embrace your essence will be restored, a home in eternity, to worship forever... === Glaciated Echo ===

fr|en|Tôt le matin, Badang est sorti pêc: Early in the morning, Badang went out fishing, as usual. He came to the river near the village to set up a fishing trap. His eyes were fierce, with long hair and a slimy octopus structure. Badang decisively threw a giant fishing net, trying to trap the monster. The power of this monster was surprisingly strong, and Badang's arms were seriously injured in the bloody battle. fr|en|Il est intéressant de noter que \": Interestingly, "4" is considered a "negative" number in the Sinosphere or East Asian cultures because 四 (sì in Chinese, shi in Japanese on'yomi, sa in Korean, tứ in Vietnamese) meaning "4" is a homophone of 死 (sǐ in Chinese, shi in Japanese, sa in Korean, tử in Vietnamese) meaning "Death", The number "4" " has been avoided in building floors, telephone numbers and addresses in China, Hong Kong and Japan due to the superstition that this number could lead to death, but it is less extreme in South Korea and Vietnam, it is considered the Eastern equivalent of "13" being a negative number in the Western world.

fr|en|===Vengeance sur les monstres=== L: ===Revenge on the Monsters=== The bio of Benedetta, the 100th hero known as the "Shadow Ranger" is revealed for the first time. Beneath the Rantha Mountains, his “Alecto” symbolizes both honor and vengeance. After returning from the Abyss, our land is plagued by plague and the entire southern part of the Land of Dawn turns into a barren place. Although the high mountains of Rantha block the corruption of the Abyss, Mother Nature in the southern realm continues to wither. This once prosperous land is now a silent place filled with death, and people call it the “Place of Despair.” The only passage connecting the Moniyan Empire is broken, separating trapped refugees and exiled wanderers from the rest of the world. They now live in fear and despair, haunted by monsters, but still struggle to survive.

fr|en|Il y a de nombreuses années, Carmi: Many years ago, Carmilla was born in Ansaac House in Aberleen Castle. As the Count's only daughter, she was loved by her entire family since birth. fr|en|Bien que d'innombrables aristocrat: Although countless aristocrats tried to woo Carmilla, none of them pleased her. Her innate pride made her refuse to bow to mediocrity. What she wanted was someone who could connect with her soul. But his father, Earl Ansaac, had already made up his mind. As the threat of the Abyss grew closer, he knew that the new class of military nobles would dominate the country's politics. Thus, he had to establish good relationships with them in order to maintain his family's social status. However, a rather insignificant man in the eyes of the old count foiled this plan. This man was Cecilion, the best opera singer in the Southern Empire. Carmilla has become his most loyal audience since the first day he came to Aberleen Castle. In Carmilla's eyes, he was so elegant and talented, but she could also see the melancholy and mystery in his eyes. For each performance of Cecilion, Carmilla would sit in the right middle of the auditorium, quietly enjoying the performance of her song.

In his eyes, Carmilla could sense his desire for a normal life, and she could vaguely see that Cecilion might have a connection to the legendary blood demon species. Although Cecilion never told him about his origins, she still chose to believe in him, because she felt his love was real. Cici, the lead actor of the Whimsical Wonders theater troupe, accompanied by her magical companion Yoyo, began their annual tour. She chose Aberleen Castle, the town where her aunt was once called the Queen of Revelry, as her first destination. But upon arrival, Cici discovered that the town had banned unauthorized performances of any kind, especially folkloric performances, and that her aunt had been exiled when the law was enacted. Intrepid, she decided to bring pleasure and wonder back to the city. Inspired by his spirit, the long-muted artists of Aberleen Castle emerged from the shadows and took part in the most magnificent spectacle the castle has ever seen. === Opening Night === Why did 16-year-old Cici choose Castle Aberleen for her show tour? fr|en|Autrefois noble prince de l'empire: Once a noble prince of the Moniyan Empire, he was kidnapped by Alice, the Blood Demon Queen and transformed into the Prince of the Abyss. Dyrroth, once the Prince of Light of the Moniyan Empire, has become the most defiant son of darkness in the Abyss. Bound by blood, his sister Silvanna never gave up her vigilant search for him, while Alice, his captor, meticulously shaped him into the fiercest and most loyal companion in the Abyss. Although not born of demonic blood, Dyrroth thrived in the depths of the Abyss by embracing its wild nature. In a realm where power is revered above all else, he deliberately precipitated his own corruption to prove his allegiance, reforging his flesh in darkness and severing all ties to the light. ===Blood and Birth=== Blood, everything in sight was bathed in crimson. At the highest point of the Sanguine Lair, a huge droplet of blood hung, suspended in the air like a still-beating heart. Sucking and pumping, drop by drop, until the flowing blood gathered in a pool, flooding everything in sight – this was Alice's pool to feed the Blood Demons.

fr|en|Voyant la force de Franco croître: Seeing Franco's strength growing by the day, the cunning Captain Bane hatched a plan: he would sue for peace with Franco, suggesting that they search for the Twilight Orb of legend together, while secretly luring the Moniyan Empire's navy to the frozen sea. fr|en|Chef de la Secte Écarlate, dans l': Leader of the Scarlet Sect, in the Scarlet Shadow in the Riverlands of Cadia. As the owner of the Higanbana, one of the Seven Great Armaments of the Scarlet Shadow Clan, Hanabi is the pride of the Scarlet Sect. To perpetuate her father's will, she has sought power since childhood. Because of her single-minded focus, she closed herself off from all feelings and emotions. fr|en|Une elfe aux cheveux roux qui vit: A red-haired elf who lives and fights alongside her companion Leo.

fr|en|Les chasseurs ont finalement décou: Hunters finally discovered the fatal weakness of these creatures. As elusive as they were, smilodons were always drawn to the cries of an infant because it sounded so similar to the cries of their own young. Hunters were quick to exploit this weakness. They kidnapped the infants of other races to use as bait and ambushed unsuspecting smilodons. Irithel had once been one of those babies. Born under a menacing red moon, the forsaken elf entered the world with strange crimson markings on her skin and was feared from her first breath. Those around her considered her existence a bad omen and rejected her without hesitation. Greed and wickedness had almost swallowed her up. Yet, in the end, she managed to survive.

fr|en|Le smilodon qui suivit ses cris se: The smilodon that followed her cries happened to be the Primary Matriarch who had recently lost her young. This little one had fallen into the hands of hunters not long before. The sight of such a crude trap sent the matriarch into a frenzy, baring her fangs. But the smell of milk on the matriarch attracted the hungry child to the smilodon. Little Irithel crawled towards her, staggering. At this moment, the smilodon's rage weakened. Looking at the little elf, maternal instinct began to take over. But the hunters had already lost patience. They approached from all sides, determined to take the bones of the smilodon for themselves. They understood the power of a smilodon, but knew nothing of the ferocity of a mother. Keeping little Irithel at her side, the matriarch rushed forward and roared at every hunter who dared to approach. The hunters were completely disoriented by his attacks and, when failure seemed imminent, they fled the forest in panic.

Keeping little Irithel at her side, the matriarch rushed forward and roared at every hunter who dared to approach. The hunters were completely disoriented by his attacks and, when failure seemed imminent, they fled the forest in panic.
Irithel had a mother that day. She was not a graceful elf. The matriarch gave her everything a mother could: milk to feed her, shelter under the wild canopy, the skills to hunt and survive... and a dear companion, her only surviving cub. Irithel returned this love in kind. As the matriarch had hoped, Irithel grew up alongside the cub and learned to chase away intruders from the forest. Bow in hand and barely able to stand, she climbed on the little one's back and sent arrows into every corner of the forest. Over time, Irithel came to understand the truth about her own origins. Having endured such cruelty herself, she could not calm her distrust of outsiders, especially humans.

Having endured such cruelty herself, she could not calm her distrust of outsiders, especially humans.
fr|en|Cela n’a commencé à changer qu’apr: This only began to change after meeting Nana, a kind-hearted Leonine girl. Irithel didn't understand his words, but she could feel the warmth of Nana's smile. Even though Irithel could only respond with grunts, little Leonine happily took both of his hands in hers. Only heat could melt the ice to such a depth, and little by little, Nana's perseverance began to change it. Proudly calling herself Irithel's "little teacher", she set about teaching her the language of humans. Unable to refuse such kindness, Irithel followed Nana's patient advice and, for the first time, managed to clumsily reconstruct her first word: "F-nothing." Together they named Irithel's companion Leo, and they walked the forest paths laughing and singing. But this simple happiness ended too soon with Nana's departure.

fr|en|Irithel a dû apprendre et grandir: Irithel had to learn and grow on her own. Before Irithel knew it, her mother had aged. Increasingly, the matriarch looked at her daughter with quiet expectation in her eyes. When her fangs could no longer protect what she loved, she led Irithel to one last place. They arrived deep in the forest, where countless white bones lay silently. This was the graveyard of the smilodons, the place these hunters had been searching for for a long time. Before Irithel knew what was happening, her mother gently lay down on the bed of bones. Like any mother, she wanted to leave a gift for her child when Irithel reached the age of majority. But the matriarch had no treasure to pass on. The only gift she could leave her child was... her own bones. Under Irithel's gaze, the matriarch slowly closed her eyes. The proud head that had never bowed in her life rested on her daughter's knees, and in that final calm, Irithel understood the secret of the smilodons: when they died, their spirit bones released their immense magic into the forest, nourishing the earth and continuing the endless cycle of life.

fr|en|La respiration de la matriarche s': The matriarch's breathing gradually weakened and Irithel's vision blurred from tears. When those tears finally fell, a glow crossed her mother's translucent, weathered bones, as if urging her not to stop there. Irithel therefore set off in search of the Tree of Life in the Moonlight Forest. With the gentle blessing of Estes and Miya, she forged her weapon from one of her strong silver branches and her mother's bones, shaping them into the crossbow she now carried. It was proof that his mother would always be with them. From that day on, any hunter who dared to set foot in the forest would learn to fear the roar of Leo and the fierce elf on his back with the magic crossbow. Together, they would chase away all intruders from the forest.

fr|en|L’endroit tout entier semblait sur: The whole place looked like it was about to collapse. Gravel seeped through the cracks in the windows, hitting the cups like bullets. But at that moment, the traveler would rather brave the sandstorm outside than spend another second at Snakebone Tavern. The traveler had come from the Moniyan Empire, intending to take advantage of the Festival of Lights to study at Eruditio. He couldn't believe his luck in finding a place to spend the night this far out in the desert. Until a group of sand hunters sat down at the table next to him and started complaining about their latest job. He wrapped himself tightly in his cloak and pretended to enjoy the gritty soup in front of him, trying not to look like their next victim.

fr|en|La reine des mers du Sud, Kadita,: The Queen of the South Seas, Kadita, was once the princess of a small island nation. Admired by all, Kadita was considered by all to be authentic, intelligent and caring. However, fate often finds a way to hit people with conflicts. Kadita was no different. As the king's heir apparent, a member of the royal family became jealous of Kadita and conspired to ruin her. An unknown mage wielding the power of dark magic viciously attacked the princess. Kadita was subjected to a powerful spell that stole all her beauty, giving her a strange skin disease.

fr|en|Les habitants du royaume ont essay: The people of the kingdom tried everything they could to help their beloved princess, but no one could break the spell. Over time, people's love for Kadita faded, causing her to lose power and confidence. Driven by immense despair, Kadita threw herself into the stormy seas of the South. However, Kadita was saved by the ocean demons. Using the Sea Trident, the ocean demons were able to break Kadita's powerful spell, but due to her skin disease, her skin was never able to return to its original tone. That day, Kadita becomes the legendary Queen of the South Seas.

fr|en|Bien que l'Ombre Écarlate lui ait: Although the Scarlet Shadow gave her a name and Hayabusa taught her peace, the young Kagura remained unsure of her true path. fr|en|L'histoire des origines de Kagura: Kagura's origin story was sketchy at best. The old man who had brought her to the Scarlet Shadow was well beyond his years, and whenever he was asked, he simply repeated the same memory: on a rainy spring day over ten years ago, he found an abandoned baby under an umbrella and named it Kagura. Nothing more could be gained from it. The Shadow Sect sensed a mysterious power within her and, after much deliberation, decided to raise the child. Yet Kagura was destined to stay away from them – the power within her rejected their ninjutsu, and she could not understand why these warriors lived and died by their nindo. Only the umbrella, whose origins were equally mysterious, kept him company, in joy and in sadness.

fr|en|Kagura regarda le jeune homme trav: Kagura watched the young man work on his spiritual tools and soon learned his name: Seimei, the legendary spiritual artisan. fr|en|Une bête sacrée légendaire qui peu: A legendary sacred beast that can take the form of a rambunctious young man, Lukas, is recently reanimated inside the Imperial Sanctuary. Blessed with a special bloodline that allows him to take human form, he once befriended Emperor Gaius and fought alongside him to create the glorious Moniyan Empire. After a thousand-year sleep, he was awakened by Silvanna and swore to announce a new era for the Empire at her side. Beneath his brash and boisterous appearance lies a pure and serious heart. For Lukas, fighting is not only his duty but the instinctive expression of his spirit. He firmly believes that he will create something as bright as the rising sun to illuminate every corner of the Moniyan Empire and rewrite the legend of the Beast of Light. ===The rising sun===

Naturally, she was misunderstood by others, mainly because of her unusual characteristics and also, since she was a dark wizard and the Magic Academy's favorite magical genius, the idol of the apprentices. This also explains why Lylia was hated and isolated by all her friends, why she was exiled with other dark magicians and also why everyone called Lylia the "Little Witch". Overnight, she lost everything and became lonely.

fr|en|Je me tenais sous l'imposant mur d: I stood under the imposing castle wall, it was just another day in my mundane life as an unimportant servant. fr|en|Agenouillé sur les terres agricole: Kneeling on the cracked farmlands, I prayed for rain to save our dying crops, our parched mouths, and our desperate hearts. But what came before the rain was our savior in golden armor, he brought us food and eased our suffering. When he looked at his subjects, I could see a whole world deep in his eyes, a world as beautiful as a landscape. When he looked up, he noticed the silhouette of a small rosewood flower, which made the world jump with joy in his eyes. Later, I was told that our savior, the crown prince of our kingdom, had fallen in love with a civilian girl. He got rid of his royal trifles and continued the free life with the girl. However, the free life is not limited to starry skies and love. It also means paddy, sackcloth and hard work in the fields. This time, the prince finally had the chance to see the truth about the world and the lives of his fellow citizens.

fr|en|J'ai marché vers le champ de batai: I marched toward the battlefield with my comrades as enemy warships once again breached our naval defenses. The black waves rushed towards us from the horizon and soon transformed into millions of blades. My comrades, my brothers, were pierced by the blades. They told me to bring their last smile back to our hometown. Black clouds rolled out from enemy ships, covering the sun. We fought desperately for our lives, but no hope could be seen. Suddenly, a golden light broke through the dark sky, driving away all the darkness from the battlefield. I recognized the Sacred Spear in the comer's hand. He was our crown prince! The sun of Mahar Pura! He blocked all enemy attacks with his sturdy body. He blew his horn to rally the desperate soldiers. Torches gathered all over the battlefield and formed a wildfire. Under his leadership, we dispelled all the darkness and pushed it back to where it came from. Later, we knelt before our new king and swore to be his feet and his spear. May Mahar Pura shine forever.

But the bright sun still shines as always on the unchanging land of Mahar Pura.

fr|en|La prêtresse de la Lune gardant le: The Moon Priestess Guarding the Forests of Azrya Born at the end of the Age of Strife, Miya witnessed the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss desecrated the Marsh of Shadows and corrupted many of its inhabitants into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis on Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to prosper again under her protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded in the fog of war. From the moonlit forest, a call to war that has not been heard for thousands of years rings out again. Miya took her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people. === Bio === “What is war, brother?” "When the races of the Land of Dawn have clashed instead of embracing unity and mutual prosperity, it is war. When they have invaded their neighbors and razed cities, it is war. When they choose destruction over peace, cruelty over benevolence, and corruption over purity... that is war." “Peace, kindness and purity... is this your wish for the world?” Estes did not answer. The outstretched branches of the Tree of Life wrapped around him and he fell back into a deep sleep. This time he wouldn't wake up for many years. Long enough for Miya to grow from a little girl, who couldn't even reach the branches of the Tree of Life, to a fearless warrior and protector of the moonlit forest.

fr|en|Miya se tenait au sommet des arbre: Miya stood atop the trees and watched for the enemy incursion. A warband of orcs and demons had just crossed the border, inflicting a wound on the Moon Aegis that caused the Tree of Life to tremble. Drawing his bow, three silver beams of moonlight danced gracefully through the branches before quickly killing the leader and sending the others fleeing in disarray. With the threat gone, the elves channeled the energy of the Tree of Life to repair the breach and restore the Aegis. Peace returned to the forest and all was well. Miya, nestled wearily in the trees, had taken on the responsibility of protecting the moonlit forest after her brother Estes had fallen asleep to preserve the energy of the lunar aegis. At first, Estes spoke to Miya through the Tree of Life, and it was through these conversations that she learned of the peace, kindness, and purity that her brother yearned for. And in Estes' absence, Miya watched over the forest according to the last words he spoke. As she relaxed and put down her bow, Miya noticed that she had injured her hand while dealing with the intruders. She began to remember the days when she practiced archery while her brother studied nearby. As a somewhat stubborn child, Miya would often shoot her bow, constantly trying to hit a leaf or branch, until her fingers bled. His brother would look up from his parchment and, with a wave of his hand, heal his wounds with the magic of the forest. Maybe Miya was too attached to the past. She often longed for a time when she could still hide under her brother's protection. Miya snapped back to attention and clenched her fist. Now was not the time to dwell on the past. She knew that the only direction for her was to move forward, for she had become the hope that her people turned to in their difficult times. But Miya knew deep down that she was only lying to herself. She turned a blind eye to the outside world as evil grew in power and only acted when the enemy encroached on her lands. Although this stopped the elves from waging war, how long would it last? Even a fool could see that she was delaying the inevitable. A war that has never been fought can never be won. But peace, goodwill and purity were his brother's wishes. How could she willingly plunge her people into the horrors of war? She couldn't; she wouldn't do it.

fr|en|\"Qu'est-ce que la guerre...\" Ell: "What is war..." She finally found her answer. "When we have been pushed to the brink of destruction and finally taken up arms for our survival, it is war. When we must defend our final resting place, the Moonlight Forest, at all costs, it is war." The Moon Elves heard Miya's words and turned back towards their home. "My people! We have suffered for too long...have lived in fear for too long. There is nowhere left for us to escape. If the Moonlight Forest falls, then we truly will have lost everything. Who will support me one last time?" At first, a few dozen elven warriors came out of the trees. Then hundreds more followed, holding swords, spears and bows. As they rushed to Miya's side, their silver hair shimmered like moonlight cascading across the battlefield. The Tree of Life also responded to Miya's call. Using its precious energy, the tree spread its roots in all directions to quell the raging fires and reinvigorated the Moon Elves for a final counterattack. The Moon Elves rushed out of the trees and completely caught the Abyss Legion off guard. They quickly gained the upper hand and continued their attack until all invaders were driven from the moonlit forest. The surviving orcs came to their senses as their bloodlust subsided and gained a new respect for the elves.

fr|en|L'immortel Roi Singe, résolu et in: The immortal Monkey King, resolute and inflexible like the mountain that carried him. Sun, the immortal mountain spirit born from a magical stone, wandered freely between heaven and earth until one day the cries of a group of pandas caught his attention. It was from them that he learned of the existence of death. Although confused by this sudden revelation, the pandas mistook him for the mountain deity. In particular, a little panda named Li Li fell in love with Sun and devoted his days to picking peaches for the Monkey King. But when a flash flood hit the panda village one day, Li Li was lost in the torrents while searching for peaches. Sun arrived too late, and despite the pleas of the other pandas, he was unable to bring his friend back from the dead. It was then that Sun suffered a loss for the first time. Unable to understand his grief, he fell into a deep sleep. Millennia have passed, and many more would have passed if Sun had not been awakened by a battle between dragons. After slaying the Black Dragon and unknowingly saving the Riverlands of Cadia, he questioned the Silver Dragon about immortality and finding his purpose. Instead of the answer he sought, the dragon gave him the name Sun and the task of being the guardian of the earth. But what does this imply? Sun was once again lost in thought... ===An immortal existence=== Before the cataclysmic upheaval awakened him, he had been asleep for millennia.

The Monkey King had lived eons and developed miraculous abilities akin to godhood. Among his many skills was complete mastery of river diversion and the construction of shrines on rocking slopes. He passed on these skills not out of charity but solely out of a desire for peace and tranquility.

fr|en|C’était vraiment très vexant. Le R: It was really very upsetting. The Monkey King moved to a higher mountain and, as expected, the mornings became peaceful again. fr|en|Il a vaincu le dragon seulement po: He defeated the dragon only to see the arrival of another, identical in appearance but silver instead of black. However, this one wasn't there to fight. Crowds of refugees had fled the ravages of war and sought refuge here. The silver dragon seemed to be a guardian responsible for their safety. However, a schism had torn him and his brothers apart. For the sake of these mortals, the silver dragon had no choice but to suppress his own kin, a painful duty that had inadvertently caused a cataclysmic vortex in the northern sea. In light of this calamity, the silver dragon had decided to calm the storm with its own body.

fr|en|Tambours et gongs tonitruants, lum: Thundering drums and gongs, blazing lights. Suyou was lying quietly on the edge of a tall building with his hands behind his head. His lips stretched into a smile as he observed Zhu'an's bustle at night. A prosperous city reflected in his eyes. Under the eaves, laughter could be heard as children wearing traditional Nuo masks ran past. “Immortal Nuo, bless the land, Immortal Nuo, our most auspicious guardian! Little did the carefree children know that right above them, Suyou, the last successor of the Exorcists of Nuo, was listening, with the sacred mask and blade of Nuo, looking down with a smile. Suyou jumped to her feet like a spring and enjoyed a long stretch. He had just woken up from a dream about the past. Over ten years ago, the sky darkened and the wind howled while moans could be heard from all directions. The lingering obsessions and evil thoughts of the dead had gathered in this place, creating a phenomenon known as the Echo of Wickedness and threatening to consume the entire village. A young Suyou could only cower in fear among the rubble and wait helplessly for death to claim him. Suddenly, a massive figure broke through the clouds with a trident in hand. His fierce stature stood between the village and the echoes of wickedness like an angry mountain. The next moment, an agile figure wielding a holy blade rushed in front of Suyou, towards the evil scourge. He was an exorcist from Nuo. With a single blow, he split the sky. With another, he swept away the scourge like freshly fallen dust. There was no need for a third. That day, the fearsome power of Immortal Nuo was deeply engraved in a boy's heart. Inspired by the miracle he had witnessed, Suyou decided to travel the country, helping people in any way he could, as its savior.

fr|en|Dix ans passèrent et Suyou se retr: Ten years passed and Suyou found himself following trails to a small town near Zhu'an in the Cadia Riverlands. The city was shrouded in echoes so thick you wondered how anything could survive in such a place. But the townspeople lived happily, unaware of the danger in which they found themselves. Strange phenomena were forming due to the concentration of echoes, only for the townspeople to look away without a care in the world. Suyou quickly found the reason. An old exorcist lived in the town and maintained a kind of fragile balance. The same one who had saved him all those years ago. Even as the echoes were about to devour the town, the old exorcist continued to lie and reassure the townspeople that everything was fine. Young Suyou didn't understand how his hero could have fallen into such a state. Suyou firmly believed that deceiving these people could only lead to disaster. Why was the old exorcist playing with their lives? The slightest misstep would surely doom them all. Suyou was forced to conclude that the exorcist was a fraud, so he set out to warn the town of the danger they were in. However, this caused complete panic and only accelerated the growth of echoes. It was only then that Suyou realized that the world was not filled with valiant heroes, but with ordinary people with their countless worries and fears. And the oversaturation of negative emotions is what creates the echoes of unkindness. After learning of the impending disaster, their fear would only fuel the echoes until they devoured everything. For the townspeople, their faith and hope were the silver lining that protected them in this dire situation. Nuo's power comes not from the heavens, but from the strength of human faith. The old exorcist has always struggled with fear and uncertainty in people's hearts. But the human heart easily wanders and gets lost without direction. Those guiding them were the Exorcists of Nuo, using faith to manifest Immortal Nuo. To repair his mistake, Suyou helped the old exorcist prepare the Nuo ritual. The exorcist had spent most of his life fighting the Echoes, and the countless injuries he had suffered in these battles left him unable to perform the ritual any longer. As luck would have it, he passed the sacred Nuo mask and blade to young Suyou to continue in his place. Suyou put on the mask and held the blade tightly. For the first time, Suyou took the stage as Nuo's exorcist: he performed the ritual dance and sang the ancient songs to summon the Immortal Nuo.

fr|en|Le ciel s'assombrit soudainement,: The sky suddenly darkened, as if Suyou had returned to the past. Unaware of the impending catastrophe, the masses looked at Suyou with fear and expectation. Only then could Suyou understand...What is Nuo? Nuo is faith. People's hearts are like candle flames, swaying in the direction the wind blows. And at that time, as Nuo's exorcist, Suyou was that wind. When people see your resolution, they will believe. When people see your smile, they will rejoice. When people see your fear, they will cower. And when people see your hesitation, they will doubt. Their faith comes from you, and the faith you evoke from them is the power of Nuo! As night fell, the faith of the townspeople under the stage became like flames and illuminated Suyou's performance. Immortal Nuo once said: “Do not fear evil. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will protect us from harm! » over and over again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to dispel evil. Immortal Nuo said: “Do not fear disaster. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will save us from disaster!” again and again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to avert disaster. Little by little, something emerged from the people. He gathered around the Nuo mask, the holy blade, and the statue of Immortal Nuo. The hopes of the people, the power of the human heart, and the sparks of their faith came together and manifested in the three-headed, six-armed Immortal Nuo. Nuo is faith, and Immortal Nuo is the resulting miracle. The sparks of their faith, gathered to give shape to the body. The thoughts of the people, sharp as an edge to cut through despair.

fr|en|Suyou brandissait la lame sacrée e: Suyou wielded the sacred blade and guided the people. He summoned Immortal Nuo and cut off the echoes of malice. He split the sky, just like his predecessor. He saw the faith of the people and heard their prayers. At this very moment, he had understood the true meaning of being a Nuo exorcist. Suyou carried the power of immortal deity in his body to guide people to enlightenment. It was his duty. After passing on the sacred relics and knowledge of the ritual to Suyou, the old exorcist left without a trace. The world still assumes that those who shoulder great responsibilities must bear heavy burdens and undergo trials. But Suyou was free, wandering from place to place, enjoying the sights and sounds. Sometimes he would perform the Nuo ritual to reaffirm people's faith, and other times he would draw his sacred blade to reduce evil manifestations. He has seen what the power of faith and the human heart are capable of, and he returns it in kind. His love for the world and his faith in others allow him to protect every glimmer of hope. Just like his name, Suyou, in the Cajun language... Exorcist of evil and wanderer in this world.

fr|en|Tigreal est né dans la noble famil: Tigreal was born into the noble Wertz family. His father Gareth is the Empire's Minister of Defense and the Emperor's right-hand man, while his uncle Eckert is in charge of the border guards stationed in the most dangerous area between the southern part of the Empire and the Land of Despair.

fr|en|Bien que des milliers d'années se: Although thousands of years have passed since the shocking changes that divided the empire, rumors and threats about the Abyss, heretics, and terrible creatures have never been far away. The whole family had high hopes for him, hoping that one day he could take up the banner of his father's generation and become the most loyal and faithful guardian of Moniyan.

fr|en|Par la suite, Tigreal a rejoint le: Subsequently, Tigreal joined the Knights of Light thanks to his exceptional military talent and leadership ability. Everyone believed that he would become a hero in the history of Moniyan, just like the martyrs of previous generations of Walk of Heroes.

fr|en|Cependant, peu de gens ont une vie: However, few people have such a smooth life. Just when people thought a star was about to rise, a heavy blow soon fell on Tigreal. In the Drylands, in a battle launched to completely drive the demons of the Abyss, who had long held the area underground, Tigreal served as commander of the Second Regiment in an army composed of the Order of Light and the Imperial Border Guard. He was deployed on the left flank of the battlefield and launched an attack against the demonic army. However, due to an error from the command center, the second regiment went in alone and was besieged by the demon army.

fr|en|Par la suite, le centre de command: Subsequently, the command center ordered the Second Regiment to leave some of the soldiers behind to close the rear and disperse to break through the encirclement. fr|en|Après cette bataille, afin de diss: After this battle, in order to cover up their mistakes, the senior officers of the Knights refused to give the soldiers of the Second Regiment the honor they deserved, and called these soldiers "disobedient" because they were greedy for merit and this led to unnecessary sacrifices. Subsequently, they tried to use the medals and promotions to encourage Tigrayal to remain silent. Feeling the stress of the unsuccessful struggle and pressure from family, Tigreal left Moniyan and came to the cold Northern Valley. In the icy and snowy north, Tigreal formed a deep friendship with the rugged tribes of the Northern Valley and, more importantly, fighting side by side again and again, Tigreal realized that as a knight, the life of a companion is more important than the outcome of a battle: because we choose to fight to protect everyone around us. fr|en|Le Tigre Agile des Combattants Ori: The Agile Tiger of the Eastern Fighters is a lively young girl who wields the Tang crossbow. Wanwan grew up in a remote mountain mansion and had a carefree childhood. It was only after meeting Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, Yin, the current vessel of the Evil God Lieh, and the other Eastern Fighters guarding the Dragon Altar that she realized that she had long ago been chosen by the Agile Tiger of the Four Immortals. Wanwan would find herself embroiled in events that would affect the past and future of the river lands of Cadia.

fr|en|Une jeune fille qui s'aventure sim: Can a young girl just venturing out into the world take on the duty of protecting the entire Cadia Riverlands? Despite everything she has been through, Wanwan still has many questions and has decided to head out into the big world to discover her own truth. ===Beyond the Mountains=== Many years ago, a stillborn child was abandoned in the mountains. The Spirit of the Agile Tiger, who was then looking for a successor, entered the scene and felt sorrow for the child who was not given a chance. So, he ended his search and gave his power to give the little girl a new life. As she inherited the power of an oriental fighter, marks appeared on her face and she grew a tiger's tail. And as luck would have it, the master of the Tang clan was walking in the forest and found the blessed child. He adopted her and named her Tang Wanwan. So the mountains now had a very noisy “little tiger”.

fr|en|Un jeune artiste martial en voyage: A young martial artist on a journey to defeat the evil God that dwells within him. Among the four renowned members of Forsaken Light, a young man from the East stands out. Known as Yin, this simple and upright martial artist sometimes exudes a sinister aura, creating a stark contrast that leaves many wary of him. Few people know that his wild and violent behavior comes from the evil God, Lieh, who resides within him. This is why Yin left his home in the Riverlands of Cadia: to perfect himself in the Land of Dawn and find a way to defeat Lieh. But Yin's struggles in this foreign land had the opposite effect; as a being who thrives in chaos, the more Yin fights, the quicker Lieh can reclaim his power. Thus, Lieh began to pass his power onto Yin, watching him sink deeper into madness with every act of righteousness and chivalry, and driving him towards the self-destruction Lieh desired. However, even knowing the risks, Yin continues to exercise this power, because for him, abandoning his code and ignoring the suffering of others would not make him better than Lieh. Yin never backs down from a challenge, God or no God.

fr|en|Pour ceux qui ont enduré toute une: For those who have endured a lifetime of conflict and longed for peace, the Floral Falls, hidden by mystical mechanisms, is a true utopia where the past is forgotten. But Yin's story is a little different: he arrived here before his life really began. Many years ago, one spring day, the hermits of the valley found a bamboo basket floating on the river. If they hadn't looked closer, they wouldn't have seen the baby inside who would have made a single sound. While the hermits felt sorry for the abandoned boy, he faced the cruelty of the world with joyful laughter. Whoever sent him down the river left him without a name or identifiable memories. Perhaps they knew the child would drift to this isolated sanctuary and intentionally left no connection with the outside world? Regardless, the boy's life began anew in Floral Falls and he was given a name. In the spring breeze, the hermits named it Yin, in homage to the beginning of the lunar year, when life begins again. They also gave him a blessing: always look forward, always look upward, because every day is the start of something new.

fr|en|Yin a répondu aux attentes placées: Yin lived up to the expectations placed on him. Although growing up in Floral Falls wasn't easy, Yin was able to learn many valuable lessons. Solitary hermits, tired of worldly affairs, transmitted not only their martial arts but also their code of chivalry. Yin was a diligent student, but the more obedient he became, the more worried the hermits who raised him became. Unlike the other residents of Floral Falls, who had lived their lives and grown tired of the world, a boy should not be afraid of making mistakes. What good is the fist if you have nothing to fight for? Without tripping, how can you learn to hold on? If we never cling to anything, how can we learn to let go? But it was at this time, while practicing martial arts, that Yin met Wanwan of the Tang clan, who had come to explore this strange abode. For the first time, Yin met someone his own age. Wanwan, energetic and cheerful, gradually introduced him to what it is to be young and free. They always played together and time passed quickly. Yin began to see the vast and complex world outside the valley in a different light. Maybe getting out and seeing the world wouldn't be a bad idea? As a sensible child, Yin never expressed his thoughts to the elders, so he never realized that they shared his feelings.

fr|en|Des années plus tard, lorsque Wanw: Years later, when Wanwan left to fulfill her duties as an oriental fighter, Yin's heart became restless. His yearning for the outside world clashes with the traditions of the valley, leaving him torn between two worlds. He isolated himself and practiced alone, and his doubts gradually became a reserve of negative energy. And this negative energy, in turn, would attract disaster. One fateful afternoon, an ominous aura flew from across the valley and entered Yin's body before he could react. As Yin struggled to resist the invading consciousness, another figure suddenly appeared and sent Yin flying with a heavy blow. Seizing this opportunity, the evil consciousness took control of Yin's body and began to fight the alien. Yin found himself facing an unprecedented dilemma. He knew that if he failed to break free from what was controlling him, not only would he harm the person in front of him, but he would also bring calamity to Floral Falls. But the more he tried, the more he became a helpless spectator in his own body.

fr|en|Alors que l’esprit de Yin déclinai: As Yin's spirit declined and the evil consciousness took more control, he began to consider a dark ultimatum. Perhaps making a tomb for this evil was the only way to save everyone... But just as Yin was about to accept this fate, a familiar voice echoed through the valley. "Yin! Don't you dare give up!" A young girl wielding a crossbow leapt onto the battlefield and stood between Yin and her opponent. It was Wanwan, his first friend, who brought him joy and a new outlook on life. As emotions flooded, an immense surge of determination and courage allowed Yin to break free from the evil's control. Seeing this, his opponent, a man with a dragon aura, stopped his attack. "Wanwan, I must face the great evil that lies within him. This boy is no match for him and will be devoured. I must prevent this disaster from turning into a calamity." But Wanwan showed no signs of hesitation. Yin had never seen this side of her and he was deeply moved. "Baxia once said the same thing about you, Yu Zhong. I believe in Yin, just like I believed in you." But Yu Zhong remained unmoved. “I won’t let anyone get in the way of my plans, not even you, and he—” At that moment, Yin, barely managing to stand up, stopped Yu Zhong mid-sentence. “I will never let my friends down!”

fr|en|Yu Zhong, la réincarnation du Drag: Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, intends to unify the Riverlands of Cadia through conquest and usher in an era of prosperity. Yu Zhong, the conqueror born from the power of the Black Dragon, sought to break the seal of the Inverted Scale hidden within the Dragon Altar and forge a new future for the Riverlands of Cadia. However, he was defeated by his older brother, Baxia, and left to die in the mountains. After ten years of arduous training and travel, Yu Zhong found himself returning to the Dragon Altar. He faced the oriental fighters, broke the seal of the inverted ladder and faced in a final battle the evil god, Lieh, who caused the disappearance of the previous black dragon. Eventually, with the help of his dear friend Wanwan, Yu Zhong regained his true identity and emerged victorious. Now that the Inverted Black Dragon Scale has been restored, Yu Zhong sets out on the path of conquest. === Dragon's Roar === During the Age of Endless War, the last of the dragon race, the Black and White Dragon Twins, opened a path to the Riverlands of Cadia to save their people from annihilation. However, their journey would be paved with many sacrifices, including that of the Black Dragon himself. To stop the pursuit of the evil god, Lieh, the exhausted Black Dragon made one last stand and swallowed Lieh in battle. But in doing so, he also sealed his own fate.

fr|en|Lieh est restée en sommeil pendant: Lieh lay dormant for millennia while the riverlands of Cadia enjoyed peace and prosperity. From within, he slowly corrupted the Black Dragon until finally plunging him into darkness. Under Lieh's influence, the Black Dragon sought to use the Yin Yang Eye to expand his dark power. The ensuing war shook the heavens themselves, until finally the White Dragon incarnated within the Dragon Altar to defeat his corrupted brother. Baxia was the only oriental fighter to survive the war.

fr|en|Reconnue par les cieux et chérie p: Recognized by the heavens and beloved by her people, the Celestial Empress of the riverlands of Cadia ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm. Zetian is the Empress of Shendu, the divine capital of the riverlands of Cadia, as well as the "tombkeeper" who erected the anonymous monument to the memory of the Ancients. Millennia ago, she used the last power of her phoenix spirit to create Shendu, a sanctuary for the mortals of the Riverlands of Cadia. Exhausted by this feat, she fell into a deep sleep. A thousand years passed before she was reincarnated at the Lake of Reflection and returned to the Divine Capital as a mortal to ascend once again to godhood. Through millennia of introspection, his determination has remained unwavering; the phoenix has found its eternal nest in the divine capital. Today, she ascends the throne once again as empress to usher in an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity for a kingdom in bloom. === By decree of heaven === Spring has adorned the divine capital, painting it with a riot of flowers. At the foot of the Phoenix Terrace, a sea of ​​people gathered, drawing countless eager gazes to its summit. At the top of the terrace, the Empress, resplendent in her phoenix dress, ascended the steps with royal grace. Although it was not a long path, Zetian traveled it for countless seasons.

fr|en|Les chroniques anciennes racontent: Ancient chronicles tell that millennia ago, the Ancients sacrificed themselves to stop the descent of the Twin Gods. The first eastern fighters of the Riverlands of Cadia chose the same path, passing down their power to protect the lands and rivers. Among the remains of the Ancients was a woman who had made a bet with the White Dragon. She wagered that even without the gift of divine cultivation, the mortals of the Riverlands of Cadia could prosper in peace for a thousand years under her tutelage. This woman, drawing on the ancient art of manipulating Yin and Yang, harnessed the phoenix spirit of her bloodline to found a mortal city: Shendu. She becomes the first sovereign. Shortly after, the War of the Twin Dragons broke out in the Riverlands of Cadia. The woman disappeared amidst the chaos, but left behind her phoenix spirit, which protects the divine capital to this day. Millennia passed, and although various noble families and ministers successively ruled the capital, none could inherit the power left by its founder. Legend whispered that whoever obtained the spirit of the phoenix would inherit its imperial heritage. Zetian had this historical tale engraved in his heart since childhood. More than twenty years ago, she was just a wandering orphan with no memory of where she came from. Her first memory was meeting a man nicknamed Wu near the Lake of Reflection, who then took her under his wing. Wu, a humble merchant, traveled the riverlands of Cadia with Zetian, teaching him to read and write and instilling in him compassion for all under the heavens. With a keen intellect, she witnessed the suffering of the people and realized that the power of the phoenix spirit protecting Shendu was almost exhausted. She thought of the legend of the creation of the Divine Capital, but considered it more of a fable than a fact. If fate does not favor you, carve your own path through your will and effort. Indeed, this maxim has proven true. As Zetian opened the doors of the bureaucracy with brilliantly composed political treatises, maintaining an outwardly gregarious but inwardly aloof attitude, it gradually moved closer to the epicenter of power. She even led armies to put down rebellions, and not only gained fame, but also built a formidable list of accomplishments. Gradually, people stopped talking about the past, for Zetian, shining like the first light of dawn, was all they could see.

fr|it|Les légendes du Pays de l'Aube dis: Le leggende della Terra dell'Alba dicono che il regno minoico del deserto occidentale ha un misterioso labirinto. Nel labirinto c'è la statua di un gigantesco minotauro, che le persone considerano la Mecca del regno minoico. Alcuni dicono che ci sia un gruppo di mercenari a guardia dell'intero labirinto. Il Regno produsse molta giada preziosa, che portò grande ricchezza al popolo minoico. Ben presto, l'intero regno si perde nel fascino inebriante delle pietre preziose. Anche molti dei mercenari incaricati di sorvegliare il Sacro Labirinto si corrompono e abbandonano il loro dovere. Ne rimase solo uno: Aldous, che non dimenticò mai il suo dovere di custodire il labirinto minoico.

fr|it|Jusqu'au jour où un dieu vint du c: Fino al giorno in cui un dio scese dal cielo per punire queste terre. I poteri della luce e dell'oscurità decimarono l'intero regno minoico, dal quale nemmeno Aldous riuscì a fuggire. I due flussi di energia oscura e luminosa invasero il suo corpo. Aldous pensava che stesse per morire. Tuttavia, i due flussi energetici si scontrarono, provocando grandi cambiamenti nel suo corpo. La sua pelle era dotata di lunghe scaglie nere capaci di resistere alla maggior parte degli attacchi e di braccia mostruosamente grandi che potevano facilmente incutere timore nei cuori delle persone.

fr|it|Quand Aldous se réveilla de sa stu: Quando Aldous si svegliò dal suo torpore, scoprì che il regno del suo popolo era svanito e il misterioso labirinto era ormai sigillato da una forza sconosciuta. I restanti minotauri decisero che Aldous sarebbe rimasto a difendere il labirinto, mentre gli altri avrebbero viaggiato attraverso la Terra dell'Alba per trovare risposte. Per raccogliere questa strana energia, Selena ha deciso di portare con sé i suoi demoni abissali all'ingresso del labirinto minoico. Stava per iniziare una grande battaglia.

fr|it|Le Dr Baker a été l'un des cofonda: Il dottor Baker è stato uno dei cofondatori del Laboratorio 1718, un'istituzione creata con l'obiettivo di portare la pace nel mondo. Così ha programmato le storie più commoventi del mondo nel cuore della sua nuova creazione, trasformandola in un robot basato su Android destinato ad aiutare gli altri.

fr|it|La mer profonde sombre, froide et: Il mare profondo oscuro, freddo e misterioso è l'ultima frontiera inesplorata della Terra dell'Alba. Dalla superficie il sole tramonta e la temperatura scende, poi è buio totale. Si chiama Mare Abissale, dove le correnti e le alte pressioni sono abbastanza forti da distruggere tutti i materiali avanzati inventati da Eruditio. Questo posto è una zona abitativa proibita, dove nessun essere umano ha mai messo piede. Solo i resti di queste civiltà abbandonate ed eliminate affondano e si accumulano.

fr|it|Néanmoins, il n’y a pas que la mor: Tuttavia, qui non c’è solo la morte. Molte creature incredibili e indescrivibili, tra cui Atlas, lottano e si riproducono in questa zona pericolosa da secoli. Erano tra gli esseri viventi più antichi della Terra dell'Alba e divoravano le creature elementali per ottenere potere, facendole imprigionare in questo luogo più profondo dagli Antichi. La potente Ingiunzione bloccava la luce, il calore e il loro percorso verso l'alto. Per adattarsi all'ambiente ad alta pressione, hanno rimosso i gusci e le strutture ridondanti e hanno sviluppato una varietà di forme fluide. Nell'oscurità infinita non c'è lotta o conflitto, solo la legge della sopravvivenza: esistenza, alternanza e circolazione.

fr|it|Cependant, au fil des siècles, cer: Tuttavia, nel corso dei secoli, alcune cose sono gradualmente cambiate. I cambiamenti non nascono sotto l’oceano ma dall’alto. Il susseguirsi di civiltà e guerre incessanti hanno interessato non solo la terra ma anche i mari. Tutto ha cominciato a peggiorare. Le creature del Mare Abissale non potevano più adattarsi a una situazione ancora peggiore. L'appassimento e la morte arrivarono senza preavviso. I più grandi tra loro furono i primi a combattere. Queste gigantesche creature fibrose spostarono i loro tentacoli e i loro corpi per correre verso l'alto, solo per essere dilaniate dall'Ingiunzione.

fr|it|Les autres ne pouvaient pas compre: Gli altri non riuscivano a capire la loro situazione, ma sapevano che avevano bisogno di un cambiamento: è un istinto di tutti gli esseri viventi. Quindi hanno iniziato a pensare a soluzioni alternative. Hanno iniziato a cercare di violare l'ingiunzione. L'unico prigioniero che finalmente si liberò del Mare Abissale fu Atlas. fr|it|Les chaires déchirées avertirent l: La carne lacerata avvertiva le altre creature che i loro corpi erano vulnerabili a questo potere travolgente. Per infrangere l'ingiunzione, deve trovare un guscio rigido. Atlas continuò a vagare e cercare negli abissi. Finché un giorno, in un mucchio di resti di civiltà, trovò il suo guscio destinato: il Mecha Sentry, un set di antiche e gigantesche armature meccaniche. Questi grandi oggetti furono realizzati come macchine da guerra dai Golem islandesi che un tempo governavano la Valle del Nord. Dopo che gli antichi golem scomparvero, furono abbandonati dalle civiltà successive, gettati nell'oceano e completamente dimenticati dal mondo.

fr|it|Le Madien du Glacier qui accorde l: Il Madian del Ghiacciaio che concede la memoria sternale nelle leggende del Nord. Aurora, la Fanciulla del Ghiacciaio, che comanda la fede incrollabile di innumerevoli mortali del nord, garantisce l'eternità al mondo. Nella sua giovinezza, sopportò il tormento della sua innata abilità nella Magia del Gelo finché i discepoli della Luce non la portarono al Queen's Peak, dopo di che ricevette un'infusione di luce che le garantì l'immortalità. In lacrime, sua madre la salutò mentre cedeva al freddo abbraccio della bufera di neve. Aurora ha dormito per mille anni in cima alla vetta. Quando si svegliò, la verità gli venne in mente: la vera eternità risiedeva nelle emozioni fugaci, come l'ultimo sorriso confortante di sua madre. Pertanto, Aurora ha deciso di concedere questa eternità al mondo. Fu in questo momento che nacque una leggenda nel Nord. La leggenda parlava di persone vicine alla morte che scalavano il Queen's Peak, cercando l'abbraccio ghiacciato della dea. Se ciò fosse concesso, tutti i ricordi, i desideri e le emozioni della persona sarebbero lasciati alla dea, che li custodirebbe fino alla fine dei tempi. E così vivrebbero per l'eternità. === La ballata dei ghiacciai === Mentre le braci del fuoco si spengono e l'incessante notte nevosa inizia a svolgersi, la storia della Fanciulla dei ghiacciai ritorna a formarsi in inni immortali. La punta delle dita di Aurora possiede il potere di congelare la neve, ma come mai possiede un tale potere? Che tipo di passato è nascosto nei ricordi che ha perso?

fr|it|Alors que les braises du feu de ca: Mentre le braci del fuoco si spengono e l'implacabile notte nevosa inizia a svolgersi, la storia di Northern Vale riprende forma in inni immortali. Alzate la voce, figlioli, e lasciate risuonare gli echi. Perché cantiamo di regni ghiacciati, di eternità scatenata, della maestosa nascita di Queen's Peak, tutto nell'abbraccio di un solo giorno. La saga affonda le sue radici sulla scia di una guerra lontana in cui, con i nostri sogni stretti al seno, condividevamo il sonno. Il fuoco ardente del Golem islandese sfidò il divino e la divinità della luce evocò il potere dei ghiacciai, tutti adornati con un design sublime. Il passaggio di quattro millenni, la colossale mano del tempo, ha spazzato via le divinità e i ribelli della terra. I ghiacciai rimasero silenziosi, la distesa ghiacciata così immobile, finché una giovane ragazza si svegliò, liberandosi dai suoi legami. Le sue dita governavano il regno ghiacciato della neve, il suo velo era il gelo, dove sarebbe rimasta la luce. Aurora, la giovane ragazza del ghiacciaio, eterna e grandiosa. La sua memoria era vuota, inondata dal gelido richiamo della notte, ma il comando della divinità risuonava con gli echi del fragore delle valanghe. "Concedi l'eternità al mondo e scendi, bella dea, dalla gelida tana del Queen's Peak." Nei vasti nevai della Valle del Nord si trova il sentiero della Glacier Maiden. I mortali cantavano lodi, preghiere ferventi e audaci, storie incise nei fiocchi di neve, una storia da vedere. "Invia l'eternità, o dea dell'alto!" “Lascia che i venti e la neve purifichino i nostri destini per sempre!” Un decreto divino, una missione velata di nebbia, ma Aurora trovava le parole enigmatiche e imprevedibili. Fiocchi di neve effimeri, alla ricerca della grazia eterna. Ma cos’è l’“eternità”? Nelle terre ghiacciate, la risposta sta nel suo nascondiglio.

fr|it|Dans le labyrinthe du cœur, comme: Nel labirinto del cuore, come fiocchi di neve che danzano in disordine, indugiano le preghiere alla dea, ma le sue mani non devono oscillare nella disperazione. Non volendo sopportare le lacrime dolorose, Aurora intraprende una ricerca per l'eternità, attraverso regni selvaggi, che percorrerà fino al suo ultimo giorno. Mentre i ghiacciai riflettono il più puro splendore del ghiaccio, la dea corre dove scorrono i destini. Perché non sigillare dentro di te l'eternità, o dea divina, e ritornare sui monti, secondo il disegno del destino. Aurora si dirige a reclamare il ghiacciaio, attraverso la neve e la tempesta, mentre le lacrime si intrecciano. La Valle del Nord, nella fiamma vibrante dell'empatia, svela un enigma, una verità assegnata. Mentre venti gelidi rivelano un antico sentiero innevato, un millennio passato, il destino malvagio della madre, una prigione ghiacciata, una triste pretesa. I viticci ghiacciati brillano di fiamme radiose, Aurora contempla l'ultimo ricordo di sua madre. Mille anni fa, in un villaggio così fragile, neve e tempeste minacciavano i tetti, una storia triste. Di ghiaccio e neve, una veste eterea, oltre il pallido, un radioso velo di luce, nel grande disegno del destino. Non avrebbe privato sua figlia della sua luce, così gentile, sola nel suo viaggio, contro la neve. Mille anni di neve, una griglia epica, una madre e un ghiacciaio, uniti nell'eternità. Nella tomba ghiacciata, le loro anime si allineavano.

fr|it|Les flocons de neige tombent comme: I fiocchi di neve cadono come la rima sussurrata dei ghiacciai. “O Aurora, o Alba”, attraverso il rintocco dell'eternità, l'eredità di una figlia, la preghiera di una madre al suo apice. Nel ghiaccio eterno, un addio effimero congelato nel tempo. Nella stiva glaciale, dove brillano le luci dell'aurora, il suo vestito, una danza scintillante, le sue trecce, viticci ghiacciati in un clima gelido. La Magia del Gelo di Aurora, nella sua fioritura splendente, la dea del ghiacciaio, dissipa l'oscurità ghiacciata. Ha colto l'abito profondo dell'eternità per ascoltare le preghiere dell'umanità e la melodia del suo cuore. Nessun enigma, questo enigma, in un'eredità antica, dono di sua madre, oltre la tomba terrena. “Ciò che rende eterno il ghiacciaio sono le miriadi di fiocchi di neve effimeri e il dolce profumo delle emozioni.” Mentre le braci del falò si spengono, durante l'infinita notte piena di neve, la fede nella Vergine del Ghiacciaio si diffonde ovunque. Vite mortali, marea effimera, come scintille in volo, solo la sua presenza dura, in potenza eterna. Con la punta delle dita guida il morso ghiacciato della neve, il suo velo, uno scintillante strato di luce, si potrebbe implicare. Anche se i ghiacciai scompaiono e i campi di ghiaccio cominciano a scivolare, la dea del Queen's Peak si erge con incrollabile orgoglio. Risali il ghiacciaio, oh anime che stai per volare via, porta con te i tuoi ricordi, i tuoi pensieri, le tue risate e molto altro ancora. Alla sua presenza, o anime, i vostri desideri implorano, il rifugio dei vostri spiriti, da esplorare per sempre. Lei ti concederà neve, ghiaccio e calore, nel Suo abbraccio sarà restaurata la tua essenza, una casa nell'eternità, da venerare per sempre... === Eco Glaciato ===

fr|it|Un jour, une chose étrange s'est p: Un giorno, poco dopo, nel pacifico villaggio accadde una cosa strana. Gli abitanti del villaggio si alzavano presto per catturare molti pesci. it|Un jour, une chose étrange s'est prod: Un giorno, poco dopo, nel pacifico villaggio accadde una cosa strana. Gli abitanti del villaggio si alzavano presto per catturare molti pesci. fr|it|Tôt le matin, Badang est sorti pêc: La mattina presto Badang uscì a pescare, come al solito. Arrivò al fiume vicino al villaggio per allestire una trappola per la pesca. Non solo mise molti pesci, ma li nascose anche con una gigantesca rete da pesca già preparata, cercando di scoprire chi o cosa stava causando tutti questi problemi. Poco dopo, il fiume cominciò improvvisamente a scorrere e una strana creatura in agguato nel fiume apparve accanto alla sua trappola. Diabolico e formidabile, cominciò a ingoiare il pesce e a distruggere la sua trappola. I suoi occhi erano feroci, con i capelli lunghi e una struttura viscida come quella di un polipo. Badang lanciò con decisione una gigantesca rete da pesca, cercando di intrappolare il mostro. Tuttavia, il mostro trafisse la rete da pesca con i suoi giganteschi denti a forma di lama e si liberò. Lo attaccava costantemente, ma l'intrepido Badang si gettò in battaglia contro questa temibile bestia, senza alcuna esitazione. Il potere di questo mostro era sorprendentemente forte e le braccia di Badang furono gravemente ferite nella sanguinosa battaglia. Mentre la bestia stava per divorare Badang, usò tutta la sua forza rimanente e gli trafisse l'occhio con una lancia da pesca, quindi trascinò il mostro sulla riva del fiume. Dopo aver lasciato il fiume, il mostro perse gradualmente la sua umidità e cominciò ad asciugarsi. Aveva difficoltà a respirare. Badang non aveva mai visto una creatura simile e rimase un po' sorpreso.

Ordinò ai suoi uomini di avvicinarsi di soppiatto a entrambe le flotte con barche veloci e furtive e di aprire improvvisamente il fuoco, innescando una massiccia battaglia navale.
fr|it|Après que les deux camps aient été: Dopo che entrambe le parti furono pesantemente decimate nella battaglia che ne seguì, la mente Bane arrivò a bordo dell'enorme Behemoth. fr|it|Bane a subi une mort tragique, du: Bane subì una morte tragica, o almeno così credevano coloro che furono testimoni dell'esplosione e dell'affondamento del Behemoth. La sua massiccia flotta pirata si disintegrò e si disperse, e la pace fu ristabilita nel Mare Ghiacciato. L'uomo che ha sparato con il cannone non era altro che l'arcinemico di Bane, Franco. fr|it|L'ère de la piraterie de Bane étai: L'era della pirateria di Bane era finita e sarebbe stata gradualmente dimenticata, mentre Franco sarebbe diventato il nuovo sovrano della costa settentrionale di Vale. Ma nelle profondità dell'oceano, un Capitano Bane distrutto apre improvvisamente gli occhi nel mezzo di un'antica rovina abbandonata, risvegliato da una luce brillante. Lo strano oggetto davanti a lui emanava un potere affascinante. Come se fosse posseduto, il suo corpo spezzato riprese conoscenza. È stato riportato in vita e ora poteva avere la sua vendetta [perduta da tempo], grazie all'Aurora Heart per la quale Bane aveva dedicato così tanti sforzi alla ricerca. Disperato per la sua totale sconfitta, Bane sorrise sinistramente mentre si avvicinava all'Aurora Heart. Dopo averlo toccato, un enorme potere fluì attraverso di lui, riparando completamente il suo corpo spezzato. Anche se Bane è resuscitato, sembrava uno zombie, poiché il suo corpo è stato fatto a pezzi durante l'esplosione e molte parti erano mancanti.

fr|it|Les terres fluviales de Cadia étai: Le terre fluviali di Cadia erano allora molto tormentate a causa dello squilibrio di Yin e Yang, e demoni e bestie vagavano liberamente per la terra. C'era uno spirito della natura chiamato Baxia che nacque in forma umana. Teneva due scudi e si muoveva come una ruota di fuoco. Ovunque andasse, le sue fiamme bruciavano la vegetazione e spaccavano la terra. Gli abitanti dei villaggi vicini credevano che Baxia fosse una bestia demoniaca e tentarono ripetutamente di sottometterlo. A loro insaputa, lo stesso Baxia si risentiva della sua esistenza. Non ha mai voluto nascere con queste fiamme che causavano solo paura e distruzione. Non importa quanto cercasse di soffocare le fiamme o di evitare gli altri, non riusciva mai a trovare pace.

fr|it|Lorsque la conscience de Baxia s'e: Quando la coscienza di Baxia si risvegliò per la prima volta, era uno spirito della natura selvaggio e ribelle. Chiunque o qualcosa che si fosse avvicinato troppo avrebbe subito la sua ira, finché non fosse stato visitato dal Drago Bianco. fr|it|Il y a un an et demi, l'Union des: Un anno e mezzo fa, l'Unione degli studiosi ha accolto tra le sue fila un nuovo studente. fr|it|Ils ont été forcés d’errer à trave: Furono costretti a vagare per le terre per un intero periodo. Belerick guardò la Terra dell'Alba devastata dalla guerra furiosa, senza alcun angolo indenne dai combattimenti. In tal modo, Belerick è cresciuto da un alberello a un albero possente. La guerra lo aveva spogliato della sua vecchia vita e indurito la sua volontà; Anche se ha perso molti dei suoi compagni, continua a rifiutarsi di rinunciare alla speranza che aveva nella vita. Ha cercato di usare il suo potere al meglio delle sue capacità per aiutare quelli più deboli di lui. fr|it|===Vengeance sur les monstres=== L: ===Vendetta sui Mostri=== La biografia di Benedetta, il centesimo eroe conosciuto come "Shadow Ranger" viene rivelata per la prima volta. Sotto le montagne Rantha, il suo “Alecto” simboleggia sia l’onore che la vendetta. Dopo il ritorno dall'Abisso, la nostra terra è tormentata dalla peste e l'intera parte meridionale della Terra dell'Alba si trasforma in un luogo arido. Sebbene le alte montagne di Rantha blocchino la corruzione dell'Abisso, Madre Natura nel regno meridionale continua ad appassire. Questa terra, un tempo prospera, è ora un luogo silenzioso pieno di morte e la gente lo chiama il “Luogo della Disperazione”. L'unico passaggio che collega l'Impero Moniyan è interrotto, separando i rifugiati intrappolati e i vagabondi in esilio dal resto del mondo. Ora vivono nella paura e nella disperazione, perseguitati dai mostri, ma lottano ancora per sopravvivere.

fr|it|La caravane s’était arrêtée près d: La carovana si era fermata vicino alla Valle del Vento di Fuoco per riposarsi dopo aver viaggiato per più di mezza giornata sotto il sole cocente e contro forti venti. it|Il y a de nombreuses années, Carmilla: Molti anni fa, Carmilla nacque ad Ansaac House nel castello di Aberleen. Essendo l'unica figlia del Conte, fu amata da tutta la sua famiglia fin dalla nascita. Quando crebbe, il suo distinto background familiare unito alla sua accattivante bellezza la resero una delle nobili dame più popolari del castello di Aberleen, e forse anche dell'intero Impero. Tuttavia, la sua origine reale fu inevitabilmente legata alla tragedia e sarebbe diventata uno strumento politico di suo padre, il conte Anssac, che consolidò il potere fidanzandola con un'altra potente famiglia.
fr|it|Bien que d'innombrables aristocrat: Sebbene innumerevoli aristocratici cercassero di corteggiare Carmilla, nessuno di loro le piaceva. Il suo innato orgoglio le fece rifiutare di piegarsi alla mediocrità. Ciò che voleva era qualcuno che potesse connettersi con la sua anima. Ma suo padre, il conte Ansaac, aveva già deciso. Man mano che la minaccia dell'Abisso si avvicinava, sapeva che la nuova classe di nobili militari avrebbe dominato la politica del paese. Pertanto, ha dovuto stabilire buoni rapporti con loro per mantenere lo status sociale della sua famiglia. Tuttavia, un uomo piuttosto insignificante agli occhi del vecchio conte sventò questo piano. Quest'uomo era Cecilion, il miglior cantante d'opera dell'Impero del Sud. Carmilla è diventata il suo pubblico più fedele sin dal primo giorno in cui è arrivato al castello di Aberleen. Agli occhi di Carmilla, era così elegante e talentuoso, ma poteva anche vedere la malinconia e il mistero nei suoi occhi. Per ogni esibizione di Cecilion, Carmilla si sedeva al centro destro dell'auditorium, godendosi in silenzio l'esecuzione della sua canzone.

fr|it|Les jours qui suivirent furent les: I giorni che seguirono furono i più felici della vita di Carmilla. Al calare della notte, Cécile si vestì e venne ad invitarlo all'opera, cantando le canzoni che aveva composto per lei. E Carmilla osservava attentamente la sua esibizione, senza mai distogliere lo sguardo da lui. Alla fine dello spettacolo si sono incontrati nel backstage, ballando al chiaro di luna. E la mattina presto, Cecilione pose una rosa sul davanzale della finestra di Carmilla, nutrita dalla rugiada mattutina, e se ne andò silenziosamente.
